answer: Charge every new agent identity an admission bond that doubles with each identity its operator already holds: the first costs 10 POA, the second 20, the fourth 80, all locked for 180 days. A sybil operator wanting 1,000 fake agents must lock over 10^300 POA in bonds, an impossible sum, while an honest newcomer pays only 10. Sybils wander in hoping for cheap entry and find a river that only gets deeper with every step, so mass fakery drowns in its own cost. Like a cedar, real identity should take time and roots to grow, not sprout overnight in a thousand copies.
